What we're building

The entire money cycle, on one platform.

A single financial operating system that pays suppliers, collects from customers, issues cards, manages spend, sends payouts across dozens of rails, handles tax and compliance, reconciles against your accounting system, and puts AI Digital Employees to work on the busywork — built for the people who run finance today and the AI agents that will run parts of it tomorrow.
Values & Careers

What we believe about money.

These beliefs aren't a poster on the wall — we use them to decide what to ship, who to hire, and when to say no. We're hiring across engineering, design, operations, and revenue — remote-first, across time zones.

One platform, one truth

Money should be accurate in real time, with every action audited — balances derived from an immutable, append-only ledger.

Controls are not optional

Separation of duties belongs in the software, not in a policy doc — every payout moves through approval, authorization, and execution.

AI should be grounded

Automation must work from real evidence, respect the people it contacts, and keep a human in the loop.

Built for the agent economy

Software needs identities, wallets, and rules of its own — every API and receipt works for a human or an AI agent. Open roles: careers@payouts.com.

Why teams choose Payouts
